exposure: Oral administration of Lactobacillus gasseri K7 (LK7) probiotics during pregnancy and lactation
Oral administration of Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG (LGG) probiotics during pregnancy and lactation
outcome: Microbiota of mouse mesenteric lymph nodes (MLN)
Total bacterial load in MLN and MG
Abundance of Lactobacillus genus in MG
Distribution of species (Shannon index) of MLN microbiota
Distribution of species of MG microbiota
Proportions of Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium genera in MG
cohort: Pregnant FVB/N mice were the participants in this experimental study.
finding: Both Lactobacillus gasseri K7 and Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG probiotics administered during pregnancy and lactation significantly modulated the bacterial composition and diversity of mouse mesenteric lymph nodes and mammary gland microbiota.
